text: HALT!

You are about to enter the Marin Passage.
This is a dangerous place for adventurers.
zh:
你即将进入马林通道。
对冒险者来说，这地方很危险。

text: Why is the passage dangerous?
What's after the passage?
Open the gate!
Your pal is fine.
Has anyone passed by recently?
See you!
Bandits and raiders usually hijack adventurers and merchants while travelling through the passage.
zh: 盗匪和掠夺者常在通道里打劫过路的冒险者和商人。

text: Therefore, the royal guard is often provided as an escort for certain merchants.
zh: 因此，皇家卫队时常为某些商人提供护送。

text: After the Marin Passage are the Marin Cliffs.
zh: 马林通道过去就是马林悬崖。

text:
The harbor and the wizard academy is there.
Also, an old tower in the middle of a lake should be somewhere up there.
zh:
港口和魔法学院就在那边。
另外，那边某处应该还有一座立在湖中央的古塔。

text:
The king ordered me to not let everyone pass without a proper permit.
This is for your own safety.
zh:
国王命令我，没有正式通行证的人一律不得放行。
这是为了你自己的安全。

text: Why should I open the gate for you?
I have a permit.
I have a permit
I need to get past the passage to get to the city Dhul'oq.
zh: 我得穿过通道，去杜尔奥克城。

text: Where do I get a permit for the passage?
zh: 通道的通行证要去哪儿领？

text: I can look after myself.
I'll come back later.
Let me take a look.

Looks good to me.
You may enter the passage.
zh:
看着没问题。
你可以进入通道了。

text: Well... Then I'll let you pass for SURE.
zh: 哦……那我"当然"得放你过去咯。

text: Why don't you come back later and stop wasting my time?!
zh: 你还是回头再来吧，别再浪费我的时间了！

text: There isn't even a city up there.
zh: 那上头根本就没有什么城。

text: Great!
But I have my orders...
However, we could make an exception.
zh: 不过嘛，我们可以破个例。

text: I need to know how my pal is doing on the other side of the passage, as I haven't seen him in a while.
zh: 我想知道通道另一头我那伙伴过得怎么样，好一阵子没见到他了。

text: I'll check on him.
I don't have time for that.

Thank you!
I'll open the gate immediately.
Then the gate will stay closed.
Thank you for checking on him!

Here!
Have a few coins.
Some people from the capital and a few guards visited the academy and passed by.
zh: 有些王都来的人和几名卫兵去学院拜访，从这儿经过。

text:
Roland, the farmer, sold some goods to the academy recently.
I escorted him through the passage myself so that the raiders wouldn't attack him.
zh:
农夫罗兰最近卖了些货物给学院。
我亲自护送他穿过通道，免得掠夺者袭击他。

text: Rair also passed by with a few guys. Apparently he wanted to buy a few bottles of wine from the academy.
zh: 莱尔也带着几个人经过，据说是想去学院买几瓶葡萄酒。

text:
On their way back, the guys ran like the devil himself was after them.
Should have hired a guard or two, haha!
zh:
回程的时候，那帮家伙跑得就像魔鬼在身后追一样。
早该雇上一两个卫兵嘛，哈哈！

text: Only the king, or his advisor Edmon, may hand out a permit for the passage.
zh: 只有国王或他的顾问埃德蒙才能签发通道的通行证。

text: You can find both in the capital, south of here.
zh: 两人都在王都，就在这里以南。
